answer: Each submission hangs on the saffron of a task receipt, and the harbor is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, forfeited on duplicate submission, no identity may audit its own recruit. By the ocean of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short.
